premise: The forest wakes one sound at a time inside a white mist until the sun lifts it off like a blanket.
inspiration: Cumulative dawn litany (The House That Jack Built): each new sound joins the ones before, and the turn is light itself arriving.
lesson: Every small voice is part of the morning.

en-US.title: Good Morning, Forest
en-US.text: {all:face sleeping} {canvas:fog 0.6 16s} [softly] Early, early in the morning, the forest is wrapped in a white, woolly mist. Nothing moves. Nothing sings. Then… {sfx:drip} drip. A dewdrop falls from a leaf. Drip, drop. A little bird {bird:face happy} {bird:fade-in} wakes up and {bird:hop} fluffs his feathers. Tweet, tweet! A bee {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:face happy} stretches her wings. Bzzz. A flower {flower:pulse} lifts her sleepy head. {flower:face surprised} [whispers] Is it morning yet? she asks. [excited] And here comes the answer: {canvas:sunshine 0.9 14s} the sun peeks over the hills and lifts the mist away, like a blanket off a bed. {all:face normal} The old tree {tree:glow} glows gold. {sfx:birdsong} Tweet, bzzz, drip, drop… {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] Good morning, forest!

es-ES.title: Buenos días, bosque
es-ES.text: {all:face sleeping} {canvas:fog 0.6 16s} [softly] Muy temprano, por la mañana, el bosque está envuelto en una niebla blanca y esponjosa. Nada se mueve. Nada canta. Y entonces… {sfx:drip} plic. Una gota de rocío cae de una hoja. Plic, ploc. Un pajarito {bird:face happy} {bird:fade-in} se despierta y {bird:hop} se ahueca las plumas. ¡Pío, pío! Una abeja {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:face happy} estira las alas. Bzzz. Una flor {flower:pulse} levanta su cabecita dormida. {flower:face surprised} [whispers] ¿Ya es de día?, pregunta. [excited] Y llega la respuesta: {canvas:sunshine 0.9 14s} el sol asoma por las colinas y se lleva la niebla, como quien quita una manta de la cama. {all:face normal} El viejo árbol {tree:glow} brilla dorado. {sfx:birdsong} Pío, bzzz, plic, ploc… {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] ¡Buenos días, bosque!

drip.prompt: a single clear water droplet falling from a leaf into a tiny puddle, soft plip

birdsong.prompt: a small songbird's cheerful morning chirps with a soft bee buzz nearby
